data.name: Franca
data.short_meaning: Free, frank, and ready to act
data.long_meaning: The name Franca is derived from the Latin word "francus". It means "free, frank, and ready to act". In ancient Rome, a francus was a freeborn citizen, one who was not a slave or a subject. The name was also given to those who had been granted their freedom. Franca is a name that signifies courage, independence, and strength. It is a name that is often given to girls who are expected to grow up to be strong, independent women. The name Franca has been popular in various parts of Europe, particularly in Italy, Spain, and Portugal.

in_latin.name: Franca
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Franca originem latina habet, significans 'libera' vel 'gallica'
